contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Base silver coin fragment. Radiate, possibly of Postumus (260-269), Reece period 13. Obverse description: Radiate bust cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: IMP C POSTVM(--). Reverse description: Figure standing left and looking right with vertical spear. Diameter: 20.0mm, Weight: 1.61gms, die axis: 6
